Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: Fixed /nearhelp casted heals falling back to yourself instead of selecting an ally. Casted heals now use the same reachable-ally HP and pressure selection as instant heals. The chosen ally stays fixed for that cast; your visible target is not changed. Near Assist and Far Help are unchanged. Automated checks are separate from live in-game confirmation.
